 Follow Plan ahead: All banks to close on a weekday in late November
 Katherine Rodriguez Tue, November 17, 2026 at 10:00 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. There is an upcoming federal holiday that falls on a weekday later this month where you will need to adjust your banking plans.
 That holiday is Thanksgiving Day on Thursday, Nov. 26 .
 Most, if not all, banks will be closed to celebrate the federal holiday.
 Banks follow the tradition of most federal and state offices by closing on federal holidays like Thanksgiving.
 All banks will reopen under their normal operating hours on Friday, Nov. 27 .
